spec_lineage_ahci.summary: Pre-release working draft; VS register value 0x00000905.
Initial public AHCI specification; VS register value 0x00010000. Defines memory-mapped register set, FIS types, Command List, PRDT, basic SATA host-bus adapter programming model.
VS=0x00010100. Added 64-bit addressing extensions (CAP.S64A + PxCLBU / PxFBU / DBAU). Added Command Completion Coalescing (CCC_CTL / CCC_PORTS).
VS=0x00010200. Added Enclosure Management (EM_LOC / EM_CTL with SES-2 / SAF-TE / SGPIO / LED message types). Added Port Multiplier FIS-Based Switching (CAP.FBSS + PxFBS).

VS=0x00010300. Added BIOS/OS Handoff mechanism (CAP2.BOH + BOHC register). Added Asynchronous Notification (CAP.SSNTF + PxSNTF). Added NVMHCI registration window at 60h-9Fh (CAP2.NVMP). Added Automatic Partial→Slumber transitions (CAP2.APST + PxCMD.APSTE).

VS=0x00010301. Errata + Device Sleep (DEVSLP) support — CAP2.SDS / CAP2.SADM / CAP2.DESO + PxDEVSLP register (DM / DITO / MDAT / DETO / DSP / ADSE) + PxCMD.ICC value 8h. Adds Aggressive Device Sleep Management.

spec_lineage_sata_companion.summary: Initial Serial ATA spec — Gen 1 (1.5 Gbps), 8b/10b, OOB signaling, FIS framing.
Gen 2 (3 Gbps), Native Command Queuing, Port Multiplier, Port Selector, Staggered Spin-up, Hot Plug.
Baseline reference for AHCI 1.3.x; adds Asynchronous Notification, Phy Event Counters, Internal Drive Activity LED.
mSATA finalized; Queued TRIM; Power Disable feature; Required Link Power Management.
SATA Express (SATA + PCIe on same connector); DevSleep; M.2 form factor; Hybrid; Rebuild Assist.
Power Disable on Pin 3; Rebuild Assist refinements; SMR (Shingled Magnetic Recording) reporting.
Device Sleep refinements; new feature flags.

key_changes.summary: Baseline AHCI — memory-mapped register set behind PCI BAR5, per-port Command List + PRDT, FIS types.
64-bit addressing + Command Completion Coalescing — supports server-class HBAs with > 4 GB of system memory.
Enclosure Management for backplane LED / SGPIO + FIS-Based Switching for Port Multipliers — server-class HBA features.
BIOS/OS Handoff, Asynchronous Notification, NVMHCI window — paves the way for shared AHCI/NVMHCI silicon.
Device Sleep (DEVSLP) — sub-Slumber link power state for mobile platforms.

backward_compat_traps.rule: AHCI Version (VS) reports major.minor as 0xMJRMNRr — 1.3.1 is 0x00010301, NOT 0x00010031.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Software comparing VS to 0x00010300 (1.3) will not detect a 1.3.1 HBA without explicit equality check.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PxDEVSLP register at port offset 44h is only defined in AHCI 1.3.1; pre-1.3.1 HBAs leave 44h-47h Reserved.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Reading PxDEVSLP on an AHCI 1.3.0 HBA returns 0; writing has no effect — DevSleep features cannot be used.

backward_compat_traps.rule: BIOS/OS Handoff is only implemented when CAP2.BOH=1; the BOHC register is otherwise Reserved.
backward_compat_traps.trap: OS that blindly writes BOHC.OOS=1 on a non-BOH HBA stays stuck waiting for BIOS clear that will never come.

backward_compat_traps.rule: popcount(PI) ≤ CAP.NP+1 (PI may report fewer than the maximum because of platform vendor disables).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Software iterating ports 0..CAP.NP without consulting PI may access unimplemented ports — registers return 0 and writes are ignored.

backward_compat_traps.rule: When clearing GHC.AE from 1 to 0, software must write 0x00000000 to GHC — no other bits may be set in the same write.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Setting AE=0 and IE=1 in a single GHC write is illegal and the result is undefined.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PxCMD.ICC=8h is only accepted when CAP2.SDS=1 AND PxDEVSLP.DSP=1.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Writing 8h on a non-DEVSLP HBA is silently ignored — IPM does not transition to 8h.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Enabling PxFBS.EN=1 expands the Received FIS Structure from 256 B to 4 KB and changes the alignment requirement from 256 B to 4 KB.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Software that does not reallocate the FIS Receive area when toggling FBS will silently corrupt other memory.

fields.version_naming_history_note: AHCI is developed by Intel Corporation (specification editor) with input from the SATA-IO ecosystem. AHCI revisions track Serial ATA Transport / Link / PHY revisions but are independent — an AHCI 1.3.1 HBA may attach a SATA 3.2-capable PHY. The Programming Interface byte (PI) in PCI Class Code is 0x01 for AHCI 1.x (all revisions); silicon distinguishes itself by VID/DID and by the VS register inside ABAR.
